facts.fact: The National Identification Authority said its Identity Verification System Platform (NIA IVSP) is the only approved and secure method for real-time Ghana Card identity verification and urged institutions to onboard onto it.

GHA.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system beyond the NIA issuing the platform.
No public register keyed on the number is named.
Nothing on enrolment, biometric deduplication or certification of the ID system.

facts.fact: The National Identification Authority said banks, corporate bodies, government agencies and financial service providers should verify Ghana Cards through the NIA IVSP, the only approved method for real-time verification, and not by eye or photocopy.
